clusters.title: Platform support and deployment flexibility enhancements
clusters.summary: Users are requesting improvements across multiple dimensions: better plugin stability for Eclipse and IntelliJ, expanded deployment options for air-gapped/CPU-only environments, support for new model architectures (Qwen3-Coder-Next, candle backends), and fixes for infrastructure compatibility issues with Homebrew and ROCM. These changes would make Tabby more robust and usable across diverse development environments.
clusters.representative_need: Add CPU-only mode support to Docker image via environment variable or automatic detection
sample_titles: Add CPU-only mode support to Docker image via environment variable or automatic detection
Add server existence check at launch with fast failure when duplicate servers are detected
Add support for Qwen3-Coder-Next model architecture

clusters.title: IDE Plugin Bug Fixes and Context Improvements
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing various reliability issues with IDE plugins (IntelliJ IDEA, VSCode, JetBrains Rider) including stuck loading states, unresponsive autocompletion, and connection failures in remote development scenarios. Additionally, users want improved context handling to include split view files, imported dependencies, and related files in AI code completion and chat suggestions.
clusters.representative_need: Add automatic context expansion to include related/dependent files in chat context based on import analysis
sample_titles: Add automatic context expansion to include related/dependent files in chat context based on import analysis
Fix IntelliJ IDEA plugin chat panel stuck in loading state
Fix StringIndexOutOfBoundsException in InlineCompletionRenderer when processing empty strings during file editing

clusters.title: Improve Git Integration and Repository Operations
clusters.summary: Users want better Git integration across multiple platforms, including support for GitLab subgroups, self-hosted Gitea, and advanced Git features like SHA256 object format and semantic merge drivers. They also need improved repository operations such as incremental git pulls, branch selection for indexing, and better handling of Git LFS errors. These improvements would enhance developer workflows for teams working with complex Git repositories and branching strategies.
clusters.representative_need: Add support for customizable commit message styles by learning from recent commit history
sample_titles: Add support for customizable commit message styles by learning from recent commit history
Auto-configure semantic merge driver for parallel agent worktree branches
Fix Git LFS quota exceeded error preventing repository checkout

clusters.title: Improve Code Completion Speed and Context Awareness
clusters.summary: Users want faster, more intelligent code completion suggestions. The first request seeks to eliminate perceived delay by precomputing accept and reject branches for instant follow-up suggestions, while the second wants to enhance completion relevance by integrating screen context from Screenpipe for better context-aware recommendations.
clusters.representative_need: Integrate Screenpipe to provide screen context for enhanced code completion
sample_titles: Integrate Screenpipe to provide screen context for enhanced code completion
Precompute accept and reject branches for follow-up code completions to enable near-instant suggestions

clusters.title: Improve self-hosted deployment flexibility and configuration
clusters.summary: These issues request greater flexibility for self-hosted and offline deployments, including alternative authentication methods like x-token-auth for Bitbucket, configurable security policies to disable password complexity requirements, and improved user registration workflows with case-insensitive email handling. Users need the ability to adapt the software to their specific infrastructure requirements rather than being forced into a one-size-fits-all approach.
clusters.representative_need: Make email comparison case-insensitive during invited user registration
sample_titles: Make email comparison case-insensitive during invited user registration
Remove or disable password complexity requirements for offline/self-hosted deployments
Support x-token-auth URL authentication format for Bitbucket repository cloning

clusters.title: Expand model support and API integrations
clusters.summary: Users are requesting expanded support for new AI model types and API integrations, including thinking/reasoning models and Mistral's codestral-embed API for embeddings. Additionally, users want local model loading to work without network connectivity. These enhancements would improve the platform's flexibility and enable offline functionality.
clusters.representative_need: Add support for Mistral codestral-embed API kind for embeddings
sample_titles: Add support for Mistral codestral-embed API kind for embeddings
Add support for thinking/reasoning models in chat completion
Fix local model loading to work without network connectivity

clusters.title: Tabby Agent Code Assistance Improvements
clusters.summary: Users want to integrate the Agent Skills framework to enhance Tabby's code assistance capabilities, while also addressing a regression in code completion functionality that appeared between versions 1.7.0 and 1.8.0. These improvements would strengthen Tabby Agent's effectiveness as a code completion tool.
clusters.representative_need: Fix code completion regression in Tabby Agent between 1.7.0 and 1.8.0
sample_titles: Fix code completion regression in Tabby Agent between 1.7.0 and 1.8.0
Integrate Agent Skills framework to enhance Tabby's code assistance capabilities

clusters.title: Enhanced configuration file and settings support
clusters.summary: Users want improved configuration management including support for custom katana configuration files, proper control of resource settings like max_input_length and completion timeout, and cross-platform config.toml support on Windows. These enhancements would give developers more flexibility in customizing tool behavior and resource usage.
clusters.representative_need: Fix max_input_length and max_decoding_tokens configuration settings to properly control context window and memory usage
sample_titles: Fix max_input_length and max_decoding_tokens configuration settings to properly control context window and memory usage
Increase default completion timeout to 1 minute and document the configuration setting
Support config.toml configuration on Windows

clusters.title: OpenAI/LiteLLM Integration Tool Calling
clusters.summary: Users want enhanced OpenAI and LiteLLM API integration with support for structured tool calling using Pydantic schemas. They also need fixes for compatibility with newer models like gpt-5 to ensure smooth integration with the latest AI capabilities.
clusters.representative_need: Add OpenAI/LiteLLM-compatible structured tool calling with Pydantic schema support
sample_titles: Add OpenAI/LiteLLM-compatible structured tool calling with Pydantic schema support
Fix gpt-5 model compatibility with OpenAI API integration

clusters.title: Fix incorrect information display in CLI and endpoints
clusters.summary: Users are encountering bugs where the system displays inaccurate information - specifically incorrect version numbers in CLI tools and Homebrew packages, as well as wrong port numbers showing the default instead of the configured value. These display errors reduce trust in the tool's accuracy and make it difficult for developers to properly understand their environment configuration.
clusters.representative_need: Fix endpoint display to show the correct configured port instead of default port 8080
sample_titles: Fix endpoint display to show the correct configured port instead of default port 8080
Fix incorrect version reporting in CLI and Homebrew package

clusters.title: GPU Hardware Support and Acceleration
clusters.summary: Users want broader GPU hardware support, specifically for Nvidia 10xx series GPUs like the GTX 1050 Ti, as well as proper GPU acceleration when Tabby runs inside Docker containers. GPU acceleration is critical for performance, so users need both expanded hardware compatibility and correct configuration in containerized environments.
clusters.representative_need: Add support for Nvidia 10xx series GPUs (GTX 1050 Ti)
sample_titles: Add support for Nvidia 10xx series GPUs (GTX 1050 Ti)
Fix ROCM/GPU acceleration not being utilized when Tabby runs inside Docker containers
